title: Arabic Grammar Basics: Words and Their Types

mini_lesson.simple_intro: Let's learn about words in Arabic! Words help us make sentences.
step_by_step_explanation: Words in Arabic are called كَلِمَةٌ. They can be meaningful or meaningless.
Meaningful words are مَوْضُوعٌ. They tell us something.
Meaningless words are مُهْمَلٌ. They don't tell us anything.
Meaningful words can be مُفْرَدٌ (single) or مُرَكَّبٌ (compound).
There are three types of words: اِسْمٌ (noun), فِعْلٌ (verb), and حَرْفٌ (particle).

think_about_it.question: Can you think of a word that names something?
think_about_it.hint: Think of a person, place, or thing.

try_it_yourself.task: Identify if رَجُلٌ is a noun, verb, or particle.

common_mistake.correction: Words can also be verbs or particles.

tiny_recap: There are three types: اِسْمٌ, فِعْلٌ, and حَرْفٌ.

key_terms.simple_explanation: A unit of language that means something.
Names a person, place, or thing.
Needs other words to make sense.

flashcards.back: A word in Arabic that means something.
A noun that names something like a person or place.
A verb that shows an action.
A particle that needs other words to make sense.

quiz.question: The word ضَرَبَ is a verb.
What does the word مِنْ mean?
quiz.simple_explanation: It is a particle that means 'from'.

exercise_answers.question: State with reason whether the following words are حَرْفٌ فِعْلٌ ، اِسْمٌ or .
exercise_answers.answer: i. جَلَسَ is فِعْلٌ because it shows an action. ii. وَ is حَرْفٌ because it needs other words to make sense. iii. بِنْتٌ is اِسْمٌ because it names a girl. iv. كَسَرَ is فِعْلٌ because it shows an action.
exercise_answers.reason: Based on the definitions of اِسْمٌ, فِعْلٌ, and حَرْفٌ.

exercise_answers.question: Find the meaning and the plural of the following nouns using a dictionary.
exercise_answers.answer: i. قَلَمٌ means pen, plural is أَقْلامٌ. ii. فَصْلٌ means season, plural is فُصُولٌ. iii. كِتَابٌ means book, plural is كُتُبٌ. iv. سَبْوَرَةٌ means blackboard, plural is سَبَوَاتٌ.
exercise_answers.reason: These meanings and plurals are commonly known.
